narrative.headline: 2020 Ford Escape: what owners complain about most
narrative.summary: From 1,449 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, structure issues dominate by a wide margin (601 reports, 41%) and account for the most injuries reported here (12). Power train problems are a distant second (208, 14%) but carry the most crash reports (4). Electrical, fuel system, and gasoline issues round out the top five, each with two fires noted between the fuel and gasoline categories. Read each area below for what to watch.
